run_teleop_server: run the teleop server with habitat or hellorobot backend on a given IP address
test_command_move_robot: test moving the robot forward, backward, left, or right using relative or absolute commands
test_command_pan_tilt: test panning and tilting the robot camera with SET_PAN, SET_TILT, PAN_LEFT, or TILT_UP commands
test_command_search_object: test searching for an object using modular learned, modular heuristic, or end-to-end exploration methods
test_command_take_photo: test taking an RGB and depth photo of the current robot view and saving to disk
